about: S-style-studio - the frame override of style-studio-2 and the undrawn states of /admin/styles (PLAN 4.1 rule 7). Account A = admin@ for every state. Nothing is written live by this package (liveWrites: []): under Q3 (a) every one of the 27 catalogue entries is dormant on pulse-redesign (catalog.ts live: false), so every commit control is disabled and no save can be fired from this screen at all. Every fixture is a list of edits over the recorded GET /api/v1/ui/element-styles, or a stub with an empty body for an error status (R26).

style-studio-1.why: language-neutral arrival (the frame entry asserts the Hungarian word, so the --lang en / de captures of 5.1 row 7 could not open): the same word by its key.

style-studio-2.why: On the honest studio (Q3 a, catalog.ts: E1 live false) the 'Legyen ez' controls are disabled, so the frame's click cannot happen and the success toast never appears (_subcheck.json 'style-studio-2 (current build)'). The override drops the click and the toast assertion, feeds the first styles read with E1 = C directly (the same edit the INT fixture applies after its PUT, without the PUT) and scrolls to the end: the frame is page 1226 drawn in a 905 viewport, i.e. scrolled 321 = to the end. It reaches the drawn table (rows A-E, C active). The toast band is not reachable on this page; it is F13's ToastHost and is proven on the kit board.

studio-load-failed.title: Elem-stílus stúdió - the styles read failed
studio-load-failed.why: GET /ui/element-styles fails: no letter, the empty hero line collapses (fix2), the '·' caption, the five rows render with none active, the load-failed message stands under the list (no retry control: none exists today, R22).

unreachable.studio-loading: the styles read is pending: the capture tool has no way to hold a response (no delay / hold rule in pulse-shot), and a replay answers at once. Built from the kit (Skeleton blocks in the hero and the rows); proven by reading, verdict structure.
unreachable.studio-saving: a commit in flight: no element is live (Q3 a), every commit control is disabled, choose() returns early for !entry.live. Unreachable on the final tree; the code keeps TextLink busy on the tapped row.
unreachable.studio-saved-toast: the success toast (frame 2's band): unreachable for the same reason; the band is F13's ToastHost.
unreachable.studio-save-failed: the error toast: unreachable for the same reason.
